messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Hierarchical model runs more quickly without transformed parameters?!
parts:
Transformed parameters are used for saving certain functions of the sampled parameters — there’s
no particular efficient gain in having them.  

Does your second model _just_ have transformed parameters?  That would cause problems, for
example an infinite loop as Stan tries to adapt to parameters that don’t exist.

What interface are you using?  When you move local parameters to the transformed parameters
block they get streamed into a buffer and saved, which can cause a substantial I/O slowdown.
CmdStan seems to handle this okay because it streams data into a file, but RStan and PyStan 
can run into problems because they store information in memory.
